about: An ingest of `hr` after the framed append, its sealed member `email` sealed in one box (log-format §1.4): the patch leaves it out, `sealed.fields` names it, and `sealed.box` is the base64 of AES-256-GCM-SIV under `hr`'s version `1`, the vectors' key, over the canonical bytes of the object of the members, `{"email":"cleo@example.org"}`, its nonce made from the source, the type, the key and the version before. Its id is made under `lakelands:ingest:v2`, the box among its parts.
